nodes.summary: For every congruence subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$, the gap parameter $\theta(\Gamma)$ is at most the Selberg constant $C_{61}$.
nodes.title: Congruence gaps are bounded by Selberg's constant

nodes.summary: For a subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$, the gap parameter $\theta(\Gamma)$ is the supremum of the set of gap contributions of $\Gamma$: the number $0$ together with $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$ for every real eigenvalue $\lambda$ of the hyperbolic Laplacian for $\Gamma$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$.
nodes.title: Gap parameter of a subgroup of the modular group

nodes.summary: For a subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$, the set of gap contributions of $\Gamma$ is the set of real numbers consisting of $0$ together with $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$ for every real eigenvalue $\lambda$ of the hyperbolic Laplacian for $\Gamma$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$ (an exceptional eigenvalue).
nodes.title: Gap contributions of a subgroup of the modular group

nodes.summary: For a function $f$ from the upper half plane to $\mathbb{C}$, its zero extension is the function from $\mathbb{C}$ to $\mathbb{C}$ that takes the value $f(z)$ at every $z$ with $\operatorname{Im} z > 0$ and the value $0$ at every other point.
nodes.title: Zero extension from the upper half plane

nodes.summary: The standard fundamental domain for $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ is the set of points $z$ of the upper half plane with $|\operatorname{Re} z| \le 1/2$ and $|z| \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Standard fundamental domain of the modular group

nodes.summary: For every complex number $c$ and every point $z$ of the upper half plane, the hyperbolic Laplacian of the constant function with value $c$ at $z$ is $0$.
nodes.title: The hyperbolic Laplacian kills constants

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be the function on the upper half plane given by $f(u) = (\operatorname{Im} u)^2$, viewed as a complex number. Then for every point $z$ of the upper half plane the hyperbolic Laplacian of $f$ at $z$ equals $-2 (\operatorname{Im} z)^2$.
nodes.title: Hyperbolic Laplacian of the squared imaginary part

nodes.title: Hyperbolic Laplacian

nodes.summary: The full group $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$, as a subgroup of itself, is a congruence subgroup.
nodes.title: The modular group is a congruence subgroup

nodes.summary: A subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ is a congruence subgroup if there is a positive integer $N$ such that every $\gamma \in \mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ whose entries are congruent modulo $N$ to those of the identity matrix lies in $\Gamma$; that is, $\Gamma$ contains the principal congruence subgroup of level $N$.
nodes.title: Congruence subgroup of the modular group

nodes.summary: A finite set $s \subseteq \mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ covers $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ by cosets of a subgroup $\Gamma$ when every $g \in \mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ can be written as $g = \gamma a$ with $\gamma \in \Gamma$ and $a \in s$, that is, when the cosets $\Gamma a$ with $a \in s$ cover $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$. The elements of $s$ need not lie in distinct cosets.
nodes.title: Finite coset covers of the modular group

nodes.summary: For a function $f \colon \mathbb{H} \to \mathbb{C}$ and a point $z \in \mathbb{H}$, $\partial_y f(z)$ is the real Fréchet derivative at $z$ of the zero extension of $f$ to $\mathbb{C}$, applied to the vector $i$. When the zero extension is real-differentiable at $z$ this is the partial derivative of $f$ with respect to $y = \operatorname{Im} z$; otherwise the value is $0$.
nodes.title: Partial derivative in the imaginary direction

nodes.summary: For a function $f \colon \mathbb{H} \to \mathbb{C}$ and a point $z \in \mathbb{H}$, $\partial_x f(z)$ is the real Fréchet derivative at $z$ of the zero extension of $f$ to $\mathbb{C}$, applied to the vector $1$. When the zero extension is real-differentiable at $z$ this is the partial derivative of $f$ with respect to $x = \operatorname{Re} z$; otherwise the value is $0$.
nodes.title: Partial derivative in the real direction

nodes.summary: Selberg's constant $C_{61}$ equals $0$ if and only if Selberg's eigenvalue conjecture holds, that is, if and only if no congruence subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ has an eigenvalue $\lambda$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$.
nodes.title: Selberg's constant vanishes exactly under Selberg's eigenvalue conjecture

nodes.summary: Selberg's constant $C_{61}$ satisfies $C_{61} \le 1/2$.
nodes.title: Selberg's constant is at most one half

nodes.summary: Selberg's constant $C_{61}$ is the supremum of the gap parameters $\theta(\Gamma)$ over all congruence subgroups $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$, where $\theta(\Gamma)$ is the supremum of $0$ and of the numbers $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$ for the eigenvalues $\lambda$ of $\Gamma$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$.

nodes.summary: Selberg's congruence spectral-gap constant $C_{61}$ is at most $1/4$.
nodes.title: Selberg's bound on the spectral-gap constant

nodes.summary: Let $\Gamma$ be a subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ and let $\lambda$ be a real eigenvalue of the hyperbolic Laplacian on $L^2(\Gamma \backslash \mathbb{H})$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$. Then $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$ is at most the gap parameter $\theta(\Gamma)$ of $\Gamma$.

nodes.summary: Let $\Gamma$ be a congruence subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ and let $\lambda$ be a real eigenvalue of the hyperbolic Laplacian on $L^2(\Gamma \backslash \mathbb{H})$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$. Then $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$ is at most Selberg's constant $C_{61}$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
